shots.content_purpose: 在一个连续镜头中呈现由<Subject 1>表演的整段街舞，让手臂外展收拢、身体律动与手臂波浪、滑步、转身、快步和最终定格全部清晰可见。
shots.description: A static full shot frames <Subject 1> from the front, centered on the wet concrete with the red seating behind him. He starts in a wide stance and swings both arms out wide, then draws them back in across his torso while shifting his weight between his feet and taking two controlled steps, the hoodie fabric moving with each arm swing. His chest opens back as a body roll travels from his torso to his hips and then runs along one shoulder through both arms into his hands while he slides sideways in small steps, his sneakers mirrored in the wet concrete. His shoulder initiates a sharp turn that carries him into a burst of fast footwork, each quick step landing with a crisp slap on the wet concrete. The footwork resolves into a still finishing pose facing the camera, the arms and feet settling, and he holds that pose without moving until the final frame while the camera stays fixed.
